description:
Get a conversation

Returns one conversation. The `type` query parameter selects which store the id is looked up in and must match the kind of record you are asking for, since voice calls and chat threads number themselves independently. A voice call is returned on its own. A chat conversation is returned together with its full transcript in `messages`, ordered oldest first and not paginated; for a long thread use the messages endpoint instead. An id that is not a number is rejected with 400, and one that is not found under the selected type answers 404.

id.description: Identifier of the conversation, in the id space of the selected `type`.

type.description: Which kind of conversation the id refers to. Any value other than `chat` is treated as `voice`.

name: get_conversation
